about: Generated by dev-tools/build_word_sounds_symbols.cjs. Do not edit: put decisions in data/word_sounds_symbols_review_en.json and re-run. Only "auto" and "reviewed" words get a picture in a packet.

statuses.auto: used: matched by a stated rule that leaves one meaning (see kinds); the note says which
statuses.ambiguous: symbols of different kinds share the name, the match is one only a person may accept, or the script author doubts the meaning; NOT used until a person decides
statuses.reviewed: a person chose this symbol; used

kinds.name: (no kind field) a Mulberry symbol named exactly the word, or the word is the plain plural of one ("plural of" in the note)
kinds.joined: a Mulberry symbol named with two words that are the word written apart (arm_chair: armchair); used as a name is
kinds.verb form: the -ing, -ed or past form of a Mulberry action; the action drawing is used unless the word has another everyday meaning
kinds.spelling: the American spelling of a Mulberry name (colour: color); used
kinds.openmoji: no Mulberry symbol has the word's name: one OpenMoji emoji is named the word (or its singular); used. Several of one name: held
kinds.s form: the -s form of a Mulberry action: it may also be a plural noun; held
kinds.adjective form: the -er or -est form of a Mulberry describing word; held
kinds.feeling faces: a feeling drawn as a lady's and a man's face; held
kinds.action with an object: a Mulberry action drawn only with an object or direction; held
kinds.other name: the Mulberry name is another word for the thing (lorry: truck); held

fields: word; set (mulberry or openmoji: the set of the file used, when one is); file (a Mulberry file in data/vendor/mulberry/symbols, or "openmoji/<code>.svg", a file in data/vendor/openmoji/symbols; empty when none is used); status; kind (how it matched, when not by name); note; candidates (the files a reviewer can choose from, when there is more than one, from either set)
